classification.difficultyReason: Decode ordered stem-and-leaf values, locate the median and half-data medians, and apply the taught odd-versus-even rules, averaging paired middle values where required.

content.prompt: Determine the five-number summary from these stem-and-leaf plots.

spec.description: Stem-and-leaf plot with the three supplied blue split marks, shown only with answers.

answer.worked:
Ordered data: $1,7,7,12,16,20,23,29,31$.
$Q_2=16$. Exclude this middle value when finding the medians of the two halves.
$$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=\frac{7+7}{2}=7\\Q_3&=\frac{23+29}{2}=26\end{aligned}$$
Min $=1$ and Max $=31$.
